ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic cross-section of a river valley; the two sides of the river channel show stepped terrain; “terrace surface” and “terrace slope” are marked in the figure, and the low place where the river channel is located can be seen at the valley bottom. Then reason: The question stem asks, in the process in which tectonic movement forms river terraces, during the stable period of tectonic movement, what processes are rivers mainly dominated by. The material states that rivers in the stable period mainly carry out lateral erosion, making the valley bottom wider and forming a broad valley bottom or plain; in this relatively stable environment with a smaller gradient, rivers will also undergo deposition. Therefore, rivers in the stable period are mainly dominated by lateral erosion and deposition.
